name: Tally
label: Tally REST — forms, submissions, webhooks
description: Official Tally REST at https://api.tally.so. Handler: OfficialApiNode. Auth: Bearer api_key. webhook.create registers FORM_RESPONSE (and other eventTypes) to the StudioQuack ingress URL. Submissions are respondent PII. Customer owns the workspace. Rate limit 100/min. api_key is never logged or returned. Inbound webhooks: selecting the :listen operation (trigger.listen) via webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) blocks the canvas INPUT port and compiles as a webhook-triggered Message Start (or binds to any Activity's MESSAGE Boundary Event).
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Do not put secrets (api_key) here. Example: {"operation":"form.list"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation when non-blank. EXACT: 'form.list' | 'form.get' | 'submission.list' | 'submission.get' | 'webhook.create' | 'trigger.listen'. trigger.listen (:listen role) is configured on the node via webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) for inbound webhooks (blocks the canvas INPUT port).

schema.label: form_id
schema.description: Form id for form.get, submission.*, and as path {form_id}. webhook.create uses formId.

schema.label: afterId
schema.description: submission.list cursor after a submission id.

schema.label: url
schema.description: webhook.create destination — StudioQuack message-event ingress URL.

schema.label: signingSecret
schema.description: Optional webhook signing secret. Prefer config/secrets; do not log.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: status=ok, http_status, data (provider JSON). Inbound webhook events (:listen) emit normalized event data on output. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Provider JSON. PII may be present — do not log bodies.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is blank. EXACT: form.list | form.get | submission.list | submission.get | webhook.create | trigger.listen. Selecting trigger.listen (:listen role) reveals webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef), blocks the canvas INPUT port, and compiles as a webhook-triggered Message Start or Activity MESSAGE Boundary Event.

configurationParameters.label: API key
configurationParameters.description: Tally API key (StudioQuack secret). Sent as Authorization: Bearer. Version is pinned on the key (optional tally-version header is not set by OfficialApiNode). Never log or place on INPUT. Keys: https://tally.so/settings/api-keys

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Per-request HTTP timeout. Positive number; <=0 uses api_spec default. Keep below the daemon invoke budget.

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Key
configurationParameters.description: Engine Webhook API Key binding ($webhookKeyRef) routing inbound HTTP webhooks to this node.
